# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VOLUME_IMBALANCE_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A disproportionate volume surge in the first 5‑minute opening range relative to the average 5‑min volume of the prior day indicates strong directional bias that often persists through the morning. This edge exists because institutional algorithmic activity often concentrates at the open, creating imbalances that signal sustained momentum when volume exceeds normal thresholds.

## Mechanism

Compute ORB high/low from the first 5‑min bar (09:30-09:35 ET). If the close of that bar > ORB mid‑point ( (ORB high + ORB low)/2 ) AND its volume > 2.0 * average 5‑min volume of the previous 10 days, then go long at the open of the next 5‑min bar (09:35 ET). Stop placed at the ORB low; target set at entry plus 2x ORB width; if price reaches 1.5x ORB width, move stop to break‑even then use a chart‑stop at the 20‑period EMA. Regime filter: only trade when the day’s opening gap is within ±0.2% of prior close AND VIX between 14 and 24; avoid extreme gap days (>0.5% gap).
